entries.text: My cousin swears {first} has the thief's name tattooed somewhere private
They say {first} got robbed blind. I say {first} did the robbing
Whatever got pinched from {first}, it glowed. The fence down the road went pale just hearing about it
Don't mention thieves near that {l:class}. The last fellow who did lost two teeth
Heard {first} pays good coin for any word of a certain pawned heirloom
A devil's clerk came asking whether {first} had reported anything missing. Nobody reports things to devils
Pixies nicked it, whatever it was. Pixies always nick the good stuff
Milk curdles when {first} walks past. Saw it myself, twice
That {l:class}'s cursed, sure as rain. Drinks alone every new moon and never says why
My gran says the only cure for what {first} has is a kiss from the dead
They say {first} was {a:background} before the curse. Now look at them
Don't take coin from {first}. Cursed coin, cursed hands, cursed house
Crows follow {first} from town to town. Never fewer than seven
The priest won't let {first} past the temple steps, and won't say why
{first} made a deal with something, and it wasn't the tax collector
Saw {first} sign a paper once. The ink moved
Word is {npcname} owns {first} body and soul, down to the bootlaces
That {l:class} never says 'I promise'. Not once. Makes you wonder
Heard {first} traded a memory for those {l:class} tricks. Won't say which memory
Smelled brimstone on {first}'s signature once. On the ink, mind you
Never thank {first}. Fey rules, apparently. Thanking starts a debt
{npcname} sold {first} out, they say. Funny how scarce {npcname} has been since
Never stand behind {first}. Ask the last friend who did
They say {first}'s own crew left them for dead. The crew's not doing so well now
{first} was {a:background} once, and loyal. Loyalty's what got them hurt
Watch {first} watching the door. That's someone waiting for an old friend
{first} still sends a letter to the capital every month. Unsigned. The recipient keeps moving house
Folk say {first} was dead seven years, then walked in and ordered a pie
Heard {first} draws the same map on every tabletop. Same coastline, every time
Somebody's been asking after {first} by an older name. Didn't leave their own
{first} came back from wherever it was alone. Nobody asks where the others went
They say {first} counts the days on their fingers, like a few went missing
{first} flinches at every ship's bell. Went down with one, they say, and came back up
{first} talks in their sleep, and the voice isn't theirs
Saw that {l:class} catch a falling knife without looking. Without even looking
My aunt says whatever's in {first} slept a thousand years and woke up hungry
They used to be {a:background}, dull as ditchwater. Then something woke up in them
Dogs won't go near {first} anymore. Dogs know
A wizard offered {first} a fortune just to be allowed to watch them sleep
{first} never sleeps two nights in the same bed. Guarding something, mark my words
Asked {first} what's in that box once. Got a look that aged me a year
They say {npcname} left {first} a key, and a promise never to use it
That {l:class} hasn't strayed more than a day's ride from home in ten years
Whatever {first} is guarding, I hope it's worth it. It's cost them plenty
The dead rest quiet wherever {first} keeps watch. Gravediggers love that {l:class}
Old Mother Ness says {first} is the one in the verse. The bad verse
Heard a priest fainted when {first} walked in. Muttered about the stars being right
My cousin swears {first}'s birthmark matches the one in the temple fresco
They say {first} will end a king or become one. Either way, I'm not lending them money
{al:species} {l:class}, born in a storm. That's the prophecy, friend, word for word
A dragon asked for {first} by name last spring. Politely. That's the frightening part
The clan shamans won't meet {first}'s eyes. Say they already know how it ends
